research_budget.model_proxy_owner: C (acp2_experience_budget_proxy.py, C T-13); B does not proxy tokens

not_verified.reason: model-call proxy is C-owned (acp2_experience_budget_proxy.py, C T-13)
LSF is absent in this environment; bsub count is 0 and recorded only

notes.identity: budget identity is project + proposal_ref (research round/batch); it is independent of run_id, so retries and restarts inherit the remaining batch
notes.model_tokens: model-token enforcement is NOT_VERIFIED; the model-call proxy is C-owned and B neither proxies tokens nor invents unified billing
notes.publication: A publication failure or retry never re-charges computation: usage is ingested once from the trusted receipt and publication is an independent step.
notes.science: budget/balance state never changes scientific behavior, TaskRequest or an algorithm result
notes.settlement: settlement comes from receipts/trusted usage; a duplicate receipt/event cannot charge twice because its deterministic receipt id is unique

cancel_after_dispatch.detail: science already started; the consumed units stay charged

cancel_before_dispatch.detail: a queued reservation released before any QC invocation is refunded

publication_failure.detail: publication retries only republish; they never re-charge computation

publication_pending.detail: publication is a separate fact; pending publication keeps computation charged

recovery.detail: restart recovery replays reservations and receipts; it never resets a budget

replay.detail: a duplicate receipt/claim replay is idempotent and charges nothing new

science_failure.detail: a failed attempt that invoked QC consumes its units; a retry is a new attempt

submit_failed.detail: the claim never dispatched; its queued reservation is released

attempt.recovery: same attempt recovery does not consume; continue/rerun is a new attempt
attempt.replay: does not consume a second attempt

bsub.replay: does not re-consume the same receipt

model_request.consumed_at: trusted receipt from the C-owned model proxy
model_request.failure: recorded when the trusted source reports it
model_request.replay: does not re-consume the same receipt

qc_invocation.consumed_at: trusted receipt per QC process invocation
qc_invocation.failure: consumes when the process was invoked
qc_invocation.recovery: does not re-invoke a completed step
qc_invocation.replay: does not re-consume the same receipt

recipe_step.consumed_at: trusted receipt for a dispatched step
recipe_step.failure: consumes when the step was invoked
recipe_step.recovery: does not re-consume a completed step
recipe_step.replay: does not re-consume the same receipt

task_ref.consumed_at: accepted submit, before any work directory
task_ref.recovery: does not consume a new TaskRef
task_ref.replay: does not consume a second TaskRef

external_iam.reason: External IAM/federation is not implemented; enforced modes are local-single and project-scoped API keys.

oidc.reason: OIDC/SSO is not implemented in this iteration: no identity dependency is approved (component manifest: pwdlib/Authlib/PyCasbin/Keycloak are all candidate, approved=0). Capability reports must report OIDC as NOT available.
